idea-plugin.name: Quanta AI
idea-plugin.description:
Quanta AI — an agentic coding assistant for IntelliJ-based IDEs

Plan, implement, review, and refactor code without leaving your IDE. Quanta AI combines OpenAI models with project-aware tools so it can inspect your codebase, make guarded edits, run commands, and report progress in a readable chat timeline.

Key features

  • Agentic development: handle multi-step coding tasks with planning, tool use, and scheduled follow-ups.
  • Project-aware assistance: inspect files, references, dependencies, build configuration, and project structure.
  • Safe code changes: apply focused patches with content guards, review refactoring suggestions, and validate updates.
  • IDE and terminal tools: search the project, run managed commands, execute tests, and inspect results.
  • MCP integration: connect external Model Context Protocol servers and make their tools available to the assistant.
  • Voice and media: use speech input and output, generate or edit images, and create short videos.
  • Remote-ready UI: work in local IntelliJ projects, split mode, and Remote Development environments.

Getting started

  1. Install Quanta AI and open its tool window.
  2. Add an OpenAI API key in the plugin settings.
  3. Choose a model and describe the task you want to complete.

An OpenAI account with available API credit is required. Terminal access is optional and disabled unless enabled in settings. You can restrict allowed command prefixes and choose which built-in or MCP tools are available.
